sections.bio:
Dr. Suren Movsisyan (PhD in Technical Economics) built the world's first cross-chain and cross-metaverse Ai web3 Agentic solution, metaverse and social media network @Aigorithm and has 15+ years of NFT, Gaming, Blockchain, AI, VR, Marketing, IT, and management, startup studio, VC, accelerator experience. He founded the World's 2nd Largest Clubhouse Club: Startup Battles (ranking as globally top 3 Club in Angel Investing, AI)! Won Monaco’s most prestigious Ai and Blockchain prize along with Sam Altman, Mark Zuckerberg, Jensen Huang under Ai, Blockchain and Metaverse pioneer category at Monaco Entertainment World Summit (MEWS) 2024 list (under the High Patronage of H.R.H. Prince Albert II of Monaco). Regional Partner and Advisor at Startup World Cup Silicon Valley HQ. Advisor at Ignyte by Dubai Government, DIFC, Agentic Ai Ambassador at Swiss Fintech Association. Featured as Ai Music and Blockchain Jury and Judge by the former Polygon CMO in the framework of the world’s first Decentralized Music World Cup Competition.

He worked with Fortune 500 and Inc. 5000 companies including Google, HubSpot, Netflix, Disney, Amazon, Sony, and others. Partnered with Chromia, Chainlink, Netvrk, Ferrum Network. He raised Pre-Seed and Seed Funding, across Entrepreneurship, AI, IoT, Startup Studio, Venture Fund, Future of Work, Blockchain, Oracles, ICO, IT, Gaming, Media, Governance, Finance, Audit, E-commerce, Wholesale and Retail Management, Healthcare and Lifescience spheres. Run over $20 MLN Paid ads. 

Founder of AI and VR music, art and NFT generation, social media network and VR Metaverse. Researcher at Copenhagen Business School for 4 years. Forbes 30 under 30 EU Finalist. Influencer, Thought Leader and Brand Ambassador. Creator of 12 unique augmented and virtual reality Android, iOS applications and games. Author of 17 scientific articles published and cited in high-rank journals, government documents, PhD dissertations and MSc theses in 13 languages across 45 countries. Co-author of “Managing Co-operatives in the Global Economy” book. Featured on CNBC, Thrillist, Nas Daily, Copenhagen Business School, Danish Technical University, World Bank, USDA, etc.
